engineeringChoicesForOwnerReview: Calendar = union over A1/B1/A2 of first entry session .. last H-exit session per horizon (one joint calendar so the bootstrap is synchronized); a session outside a book's own span, or with an empty book, holds 069500.KS 100% in BOTH books (D_t = 0) and stays in the mean (total-capital basis).
Rebalance only at the close of a session where the active slot set changes; otherwise drift.
Equal target capital per active slot; slot = q stock + (1-q) cash vs q*beta ETF + (1-q*beta) cash, q = 1/max(1,beta) fixed at entry.

A name not tradable (zero volume) on a rebalance close keeps its drifted weight; the rest of the book is rescaled around it. An event whose entry session is not tradable is a pre-trade eligibility failure (not held), counted.
Costs: stock buy = commission + half spread, sell adds the dated transaction tax; ETF each way = commission + half spread, no tax; cash free. 2x/3x scale every friction and the tax.
A held name with no level and no admitted terminal consideration makes the path incomplete (paired outcome None -> SOURCE_BLOCKED); it is never zero-filled or last-priced.
Beta: OLS of stock on 069500.KS daily total returns over the 252 returns ending at the SIGNAL session, >= 200 joint pairs; beta < 0 or unestimable -> not investable, counted.
Bootstrap: synchronized (non-circular) moving blocks over the joint calendar, basic CI on the centred mean, two-sided p = (1 + #|m*-m| >= |m|)/(B+1).
Dependence check: UNCERTAIN_DEPENDENCE when the sign of the simultaneous lower bound differs between the primary bootstrap, Bartlett HAC normal interval and either sensitivity block.

Regime checks (point estimates on event subsets): pre/post Value-up by entry date, and the book without entries in 2025-01-01..2026-12-31. Industry check: the book without the PIT research industry holding the most events (pinned outcome-free in the readiness file).

Matched check: 3 nearest non-event peers on standardized log mcap, B/M, 12-1 momentum, 21-session return, beta, exact PIT industry first (B1 mandatory). Measured iff a two-way (issuer x entry-week) clustered SE exists.
